explanation: Grasp stage only. No motion was acknowledged, so the original frame-0 measurements remain useful after an explicit provenance check. Audit the rejected candidate using the full finite pad height: a pad center above the package top can still provide side-wall overlap. Preserve the 6 mm finger/table requirement, add a measured-surface allowance, and require 3 mm common pad overlap plus pose reserve. Move only through a reviewed free-air route to a closer observation pose, then obtain targeted side/top/table measurements before descent. Close once, perform a bounded vertical retention test, and require fresh visible separation and rigid following. No bowl alignment, release or whole-task verification code is included.
interface: Complete Python main(api), using only the supplied API, np, math and geo. Returns stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. grasp_stage_v1 is preserved as the original measurement and rejected-candidate record. grasp_stage_v2 stores source-frame validation, numerical finite-pad audit, visible top/table geometry, targeted current side measurements, same-package tracker identity and handle, phase, pending action intent, acknowledged receipt, actual contact margins, prelift_state/prelift_transform, retention metrics and fresh effect evidence. Saved pixels are only used before any movement at their validated original frame. A pending unreceipted action or interrupted closure blocks automatic repetition. Handoff contains checkpoint references, frames, assumptions and measured package-to-tool geometry, never later-stage control code.
jev_protocol: Every physical action uses api.control and real Jev. Exactly seven questions explicitly bind x/y/z to the corresponding world translation relation, rx/ry/rz to the corresponding world rotation-vector relation, and gripper to objective.gripper. Negative decreases, positive increases, and hold means within tolerance; open, close and keep deliver the requested command unchanged. Program features contain source-labelled numerical pad/finger geometry, package dimensions, registration quality and retention metrics; the host supplies trusted residuals and axis relations. Jev does not calculate geometry, see undeclared imagery, certify clearance or judge retention. The program interprets unchanged receipts, stops at the first translation stall or detected command mismatch, and never automatically reopens. At most 22 three-step controls and 66 native steps fit below the 24/72 slice limits; checkpoints and yield preserve partial progress. Translation limits are 20 mm for free-air approach, 8 mm for descent, 4 mm for closure and 10 mm for lift; rotation limit is 0.10 rad. Position tolerances are 3 mm, 0.5 mm, 0.5 mm and 2 mm respectively; rotation tolerance is 0.01 rad. Actual preclosure geometry must retain 6 mm table clearance and 3 mm common vertical overlap after the surface allowance. Typed fresh reviews establish visible identity and corridors, not hidden geometry. Failed requested depths receive at most one different-patch/view retry. Registration checks precede and follow motion; unknown or inadequate registration stops. Stage completion requires hand rise at least 35 mm, package rise at least 30 mm, rigid-following discrepancy at most 8 mm, adequate same-patch registration, and a fresh review and depth evidence of visible independent lifting without apparent slip. Reached or closure alone never establishes the stage effect.
